team: Both hit 4 of 5 planned sessions and both pulled 225 lb on the trap bar; Fred missed Tuesday, Will missed Friday. Saturday was the first 4 x 1 km sim: Fred 33:52 measured, Will 35:22 estimated (laps not tapped) while feeling sick. Next week is a deload, so take it as one.

fred.headline: Sled pull leaps, Tuesday runs went missing
fred.summary: Four of five planned sessions: Monday (done Tuesday), hockey, a full Friday and the stations 1 to 4 sim, plus an extra push day; Tuesday's 5 x 600 m was replaced by a logged rest day. Average RPE fell from 7.6 to 6.8 and knee pain peaked at 2 on Friday. Run volume was about 5.5 of 9 km (4 km sim plus your 10 min treadmill run after the Friday EMOM), and the sim came in at 33:52 at RPE 8.
strengths: Sled pull 24 m at 170 lb: 2:54 in week 1, 1:47 today. Sled push 1:22 to 1:10 and burpee broad jumps faster over a longer 40 m.
Full Friday done: unassisted pull ups, DB bench 55 lb at RIR 2, face pulls 60 lb, and the wall ball EMOM was 20+ with 200 m extra on the rower.
Farmers carry already at race weight (53 lb per hand) with 20 s spare each minute over 48 m.
weaknesses: Tuesday intervals skipped, so run km stayed well under the 9 km target for the third week.
Sim runs faded 6:13, 6:31, 6:36, 6:48: a 35 s spread, target is 10 to 15 s.
Trap bar 225 lb went 6, 6 and 8 reps instead of 3 x 5 at RIR 1, and you wrote the lower back hurt a bit.
tips: Trap bar: stop each set at the planned 5 reps. Extra reps at RIR 1 with a sore lower back is the wrong trade; the load goes up next build week instead.
On sim runs, start the first km at the pace you can hold on the fourth. Today that means opening at about 6:30, not 6:13, and aiming for all four within 15 s.

Weekly body weight average went 157.4, 158.7, 160.9 lb, about 1.7 lb a week up. Keep both weigh-ins so we can see whether it settles. Also log the hack squat top set exactly: your note says 160 lb, the Loads line says 170.

tweaks.text: Do the deload Tuesday this time: 4 x 400 m easy plus arms at 2 sets each, so the run streak restarts before week 5's 4 x 1 km.
Deload: trap bar 2 x 5 at 180 lb and hack squat 2 x 8 at 135 lb, and if the lower back is still sore in the warm up, keep the trap bar at 135 lb.

will.headline: Strength up, Friday missing, rest up
will.summary: Four of five planned sessions: Monday, Tuesday (done Wednesday), hockey and the sim; Friday was not logged and there is no rest day to explain it. Average RPE rose from 6.0 to 7.3, knee pain hit 3 again on Monday, and you wrote that you felt sick and tired on Saturday. Run volume was 5.8 of 9 km; the sim total of 35:22 is an estimate because the laps were not tapped, so do not judge it.
strengths: Trap bar up 20 lb to 225 lb at RIR 2, hack squat 160 lb at RIR 1.
Monday sled push went from 155 to 190 lb after you said it was too light.
Very even 600 m reps on the assault runner: 3:27, 3:29, 3:27 (about 5:45 per km).
weaknesses: Friday missed for the second time in three weeks.
Only 3 of the 5 x 600 m logged (1.8 km), and laterals, curls and triceps were all RIR 0 for two weeks running.
Sim laps not tapped, so we have no real station or run splits from today.
tips: You felt sick on Saturday: this deload week is the right time to recover. Sleep and eat normally, and only train if you have no fever or chest symptoms.
In the sim, tap the big bottom button after every run and every station. It takes 1 s and it is the only way the coach can see where your time goes.
Arms: all three were RIR 0, so this week use the deload loads and stop each set with 1 to 2 reps left. Also add a Thursday weigh-in; body weight is stable at 184.6 to 185.4 lb on Mondays.

tweaks.text: If you are still sick with fever or anything in the chest, skip the sim and log a rest day; if it is only a runny nose, do it at 70% and tap every lap.
Do Friday even short: assisted pull ups 2 x 5 at 75 lb assistance, DB bench 2 x 5 at 40 lb, face pulls and crunch at 2 sets.
